name: Galveston County, TX
findings: Galveston County has 946 nonprofit organizations. 348 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 274 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Galveston County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Galveston County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 8 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 92 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
